flag_explanations.title: Artificial Additives
flag_explanations.explanation: Artificial colors, flavors, and preservatives are synthetic compounds your body doesn't need. Some (like BHT, BHA, certain dyes) have been linked to health concerns in research. Simpler ingredient lists avoid these.
